name: Nanaka
message: "Hmm? Can't hear you~? Morning greetings should be loud and clear!"
For some reason, there is a basin full of water right in front of him. The goldfish, Kin-kun, is flapping about merrily.

name: Synn
message: "How could you do such a terrible thing! Have a heart for Kin-kun!"

name: Nanaka
message: "Well, you were rowing away in your sleep, so I couldn't resist floating you in some water."

name: Synn
message: "I was asleep? Then all of that was..."

name: Nanaka
message: "A dream? Was it a good one at least?"

name: Synn
message: "Of course. A wonderful, happy dream packed full of hope."

name: Nanaka
message: "You woke up to breakfast already made, bumped into a girl on the way to school, got a tiered bento with no regard for food pairings, had an early lunch..."

name: Nanaka
message: "Somehow had money, could only think of lending it out stingily, unleashed a finisher to save the school, then karaoke, cider, and beef steak."

name: Synn
message: "I never got to eat the beef! And it was your fault!"

name: Nanaka
message: "Hmm~. Then the rest was on the mark."

name: Synn
message: "Hey!? Don't make fun of food! To such a naughty child...!"

name: Nanaka
message: "Geh! You're opening your jacket―don't tell me!"

name: Synn
message: "Heh heh heh. That's exactly it. Let me have you taste my extra-rich milk."

name: Nanaka
message: "Eek! Not that much again today!? Not white and thick, please no!"

name: Synn
message: "I'll pour plenty of it down that cheeky mouth of yours!"

name: Misa
message: "Su-, su-su-such debauchery, in the student council room of all places!"

name: Synn
message: "Eh? What are you talking about? This is perfectly wholesome."

name: Misa
message: "Stop, or I'll scream at the top of my lungs! I'll call people here!"

name: Synn
message: "Just because you're the Vice-President doesn't mean you get to be tyrannical! I was only..."

name: Nanaka
message: "Please, Misa! Think of it as a rescue―drink it in my place!"

name: Misa
message: "Eh!? Wait, what is going on here!?"

name: Nanaka
message: "I've been forced to drink it since I was little, and I'm sick of it!"

name: Misa
message: "I don't follow at all, but heh heh heh... Filthy! It's filthy!"

name: Synn
message: "Even though it's pasteurized, so it's full of nutrients, too."

name: Nanaka
message: "Uuu. Milk is gross... milk is gross..."

name: Nanaka
message: "You thought it was yogurt, didn't you?"

name: Synn
message: "I brought it back for you, Nanaka."

name: Nanaka
message: "None of your business! Drink it yourself!"

name: Nanaka
message: "Haa~. Lucky you. Everything and anything is 'delicious, delicious' with you."

name: Synn
message: "If you're a picky eater, you won't grow big, you know."

name: Misa
message: "Wha-!? Those were supposed to be MY lines...!"

name: Misa
message: "Unforgivable, being late out of nowhere. I'll go fetch her."

name: Misa
message: "No, thank you. You would only get in the way anyway."

name: Misa
message: "The one seeking the mummy becomes a mummy herself, you see."

name: Misa
message: "Wouldn't you agree? Someone making a fuss over milk is a lost cause."

name: Nanaka
message: "What does that have to do with milk!?"

name: Misa
message: "Anyone who abandons things halfway can hardly be trusted to reach her destination, that's all."

name: Synn
message: "The closer the quarrel, the stronger the bond... as they say."
A girl stands by the window, a pig held tenderly to her chest as she reads with elegant grace.
A sheltered young lady―like an angel descended for the sake of hopeless creatures such as us.
I can even see her wings. Tiny, adorable little wings.
Gone. So it was a dream after all!?

name: Lolotte
message: "There are no such things as wings."

name: Lolotte
message: "I said there are none, and none there are!!"
She turns away in a huff.
And resumes reading, paying me no mind whatsoever. Picturesque cuteness.
As expected of the girl the whole school talks about.
He turns his gaze away to hide his embarrassment.

name: Lolotte
message: "I only just arrived this very moment, of course."

name: Nanaka
message: "You could at least greet people when you show up."

name: Lolotte
message: "'What the eye does not see, the heart does not grieve over.' Is that not what they say?"

name: Nanaka
message: "Well, she's a transfer student from abroad, so what can you do."

name: Synn
message: "Yeah. Less 'goddess of mercy', more 'cute little angel', though."

name: Misa
message: "Honestly, you go off track so easily! This is no time to be playing around!?"

name: Lolotte
message: "\{Commi|\s12\s12\s12}unication is about everyone playing happily together―that is what the guidebook says, at least."

name: Nanaka
message: "That thing you've been leafing through this whole time? That's the guidebook?"

name: Lolotte
message: "Yes. It is titled 'True Stories: The Human World'―"

name: Lolotte
message: "I rather doubt you would be able to read it."

name: Synn
message: "It's probably written in a language from another world, after all."

name: Misa
message: "BAD communication! What we gathered here for today is―"

name: Misa
message: "You weren't wrong, and there's no 'might' about it―it's a meeting!"

name: Synn
message: "There's barely any time left until the inauguration address, after all."

name: Nanaka
message: "A meeting means tea! Here you go, tea. Enjoy."

name: Nanaka
message: "Ahh... tea is lovely. So soothing. Zzz..."

name: Misa
message: "―this is no time to be relaxing!"

name: Misa
message: "That's right. Anyone who actually came prepared, raise your hand."

name: Synn
message: "Isn't that what this meeting is for...?"

name: Misa
message: "A meeting means deciding what to discuss in advance. Coming unprepared makes you a failure of a President."

name: Synn
message: "Th-that's not true at all―! Aim for a sparkling school life!"

name: Synn
message: "'Sparkling' just feels like it would put us in a richer mood, don't you think?"

name: Misa
message: "Simple words. But can something like that truly win over the students' hearts?"

name: Nanaka
message: "Well then, President, show off that marvelous address of yours."
Misa grins proudly and produces a scroll from her pocket.

name: Misa
message: "On this most auspicious of days, we humbly pray for ever greater prosperity to each and every―"

name: Nanaka
message: "Ah, forget it, I get it! It's oozing out of you! Brimming over!"

name: Lolotte
message: "Um... how much of it did you write?"

name: Misa
message: "The beginning is everything. If we don't do things this properly, the student council's dignity won't hold."

name: Lolotte
message: "Um, could you roll it back up a little more neatly? It is sticking out sideways, ever so slightly, and it troubles me."

name: Misa
message: "Whatever! I don't care about such things!"

name: Nanaka
message: "But this comes after morning assembly, right? Right after the principal's 'grateful words'."

name: Lolotte
message: "One would drift off into dreamy bliss listening to it."

name: Nanaka
message: "Well, it'd end like that, wouldn't it."
"At this rate, karaoke and toasts won't even be in the picture\s07"
"This is exactly when the President should shine, you know♪"

name: Misa
message: "...Senpai. What do you make of this spectacle?"

name: Misa
message: "See! A student council like this is impossible!"

name: Nanaka
message: "At this rate, won't there be a vote of no confidence and dissolution or something?"

name: Synn
message: "Ahaha, what a bad joke. It's not like we're the Diet."

name: Lolotte
message: "Ooh, exciting. Something ominous is in the air♪"

name: Ria
message: "I believe it was back when I was a first-year..."

name: Ria
message: "The student council officers lined up to give their address, and―"

name: Former Vice-President
message: "KYAHAHA! Your back is completely exposed! Now's my big chance to destroy the student council President!"

name: Former President
message: "This is why I let no one stand behind me. And so I go on hurting yet another person."

name: Misa
message: "I hardly think we need to hear the rest."

name: Ria
message: "And just like that, the student council was dissolved. The end."

name: Nanaka
message: "How did people like that even get elected, though?"

name: Nanaka
message: "Ah, wait, a live example is happening right now!"

name: Misa
message: "As if I would!! If I did, it would be from the front!!"

name: Synn
message: "And then I fish for tuna on a distant ocean trawler"

name: Synn
message: "Then what... what am I even supposed to do with my life from here...!"

name: Ria
message: "Come now. I said it before, didn't I? This is exactly when the President's moment arrives."

name: Misa
message: "Once everyone understands that you lack the caliber of a student council President, that's all that matters."

name: Misa
message: "And then we learn who is truly worthy... what a splendid arrangement♪"

name: Ria
message: "But you can't run again after dissolution. Are you sure that's all right?"

name: Synn
message: "Besides, we'd be in trouble if such an excellent Vice-President quit right now."

name: Misa
message: "W-well, it would be a waste to throw away my excellence..."

name: Misa
message: "Besides, Sakura-kun alone is too unreliable, so I suppose I can overlook the dissolution."

name: Ria
message: "Mm-hm. I think that's the right call."
Misa has fallen. The dissolution is averted.

name: Nanaka
message: "Hey hey, don't forget about me either."

name: Synn
message: "I know, I know. I'm counting on you, Nanaka."

name: Nanaka
message: "You got it! Leave it to me!"

name: Synn
message: "Lolotte, you'll give the address with us too, right?"

name: Lolotte
message: "Hmm, would someone such as I truly suffice?"

name: Synn
message: "Of course! The student council needs your strength."

name: Lolotte
message: "But... speaking before a crowd like that is, how to say, a rather nerve-racking prospect..."

name: Synn
message: "I'm begging you, Lolotte. If only you pull through, everyone in the student council will be saved."

name: Lolotte
message: "Everyone is in trouble. Then helping you is only natural!"
And now we can raise our own flag.

name: Synn
message: "All right! Let's give it everything we've got, together!"

name: Misa
message: "If we're doing this, we do it thoroughly."

name: Nanaka
message: "Obviously! Total annihilation, not one blade of grass left!"

name: Lolotte
message: "I don't quite follow, but I feel excited!!"

name: Ria
message: "Hee hee. For all your squabbling, you pull things together so nicely."

name: Synn
message: "Now is the time to show everyone our true, earnest feelings―!"
